title: Type Marks with ZEN Type Marks by Family: one run per family group, the search string becomes the prefix, Overwrite on for a clean re-run
use_when: A model has no or inconsistent Type Marks and the types can be grouped by a word in the family name
Type Marks must be redone after the grouping changed
not_for: Pipe, duct and fitting system types (no family-name group); leave them or mark them by system
Firm-specific code lists that do not follow family names: enter the code as the search string only if family names contain it

environment.batch_tool: ZEN 1.2 (ACC Gate Export Schedules, Type Marks by Family)
environment.model: Autodesk sample Snowdon Towers, 6 workshared ACC cloud discipline models

changelog.change: First recorded (IN-0020, curator session with the owner)
